# default-as-flag

<!-- Generated by swift-argument-parser -->

A utility demonstrating defaultAsFlag options.

```
default-as-flag [--string-flag=<string-flag>]
  [--number-flag=<number-flag>] [--bool-flag=<bool-flag>]
  [--transform-flag=<transform-flag>] [--regular=<regular>]
  [-v] [<additional-args>...] [--help]
```

This command shows how defaultAsFlag options can work both as flags
and as options with values.

- term **--string-flag=\<string-flag\>**:

*A string option with defaultAsFlag.*


- term **--number-flag=\<number-flag\>**:

*An integer option with defaultAsFlag.*


- term **--bool-flag=\<bool-flag\>**:

*A boolean option with defaultAsFlag.*


- term **--transform-flag=\<transform-flag\>**:

*A string option with transform and defaultAsFlag.*


- term **--regular=\<regular\>**:

*A regular option for comparison.*


- term **-v**:
